Arsenal.note: Tzolis (hamstring) and Havertz (thigh), both picked up on international duty; Saliba out since July with a back injury (extended layoff, still listed absent as of Oct 5). Hincapie hurt his ankle during post-match warm-down after the 2-1 Leeds win (10 Oct); no official diagnosis but multiple reports say he is unlikely to be available in the short term, putting the Lille match in doubt. Sources: Sports Mole injury list, lastwordonsports.com (6 Oct), arseblog.news, khelnow.com (12 Oct), dailyafc.com; Hincapie corroborated by Sports Mole (multiple pieces), roundtable.io, capitalfm.africa, si.com, dailycannon.com (11-12 Oct). A single khelnow report also claims a fresh ankle injury to Zubimendi (12 Oct) but this remains uncorroborated elsewhere -- not added.

RB Leipzig.note: Guiu: left hamstring injury confirmed by the club 18 Sep, out for several weeks (ms-aktuell.de, corroborated across multiple match previews). Ouedraogo: shoulder injury recurred after his comeback and required a new operation (90min.de, qatar-tribune.com). Baumgartner: thigh injury, listed out for the PSV fixture (starting11.com fixture page) and separately reported unavailable through injury in a 29-30 Sep squad-depth report (roundtable.io). Reitz: muscle/hamstring issue, listed doubtful for this fixture (starting11.com); a Sportsdunia injury-tracker entry puts his hamstring injury window at 3 Sep-9 Oct, consistent with a borderline return. Abdoul Kone and Leopold Zingerle appear on one tracker (sportsdunia.com) with an unexplained '3 Sep 2026-28 Jan 2027' eligibility/absence flag, but Kone's only sourced injury (a July shoulder problem, getfootballnewsgermany.com) should have resolved months ago and no second source confirms either as currently out -- not added, flagged as unverified.

Sildillia: sidelined for several more weeks per the same 2 Oct report, also flagged as a long-term absentee by independent match previews. Wanner: foot injury from Austria duty, out several weeks (roundtable.io 29 Sep, starting11.com). Pepi: out several weeks after a knock vs FC Twente (roundtable.io 2 Oct, starting11.com). Ouaissa: ankle problem, still building back to full training (roundtable.io, starting11.com). Lammers: short of full match fitness (roundtable.io, starting11.com) -- per Flashscore, PSV currently have no fit senior striker. Schouten: long-term knee issue, not expected back until 2027 (roundtable.io 3 Oct, starting11.com). Geertruida: minor knock from Netherlands duty, doubtful not ruled out (roundtable.io 26 Sep, starting11.com). Re-checked for this FC Porto fixture (20 Oct): no newer contradicting report found; a starting11 preview gives no clear PSV injury update either way, so the above stands. Re-checked again (20 Oct, matchday) for the FC Porto fixture: no newer report found; the above (12-19 Oct sourcing) stands unchanged.

Liverpool.note: Manager Andoni Iraola said it is highly unlikely Isak (thigh), Gakpo (ankle) and Szoboszlai (hamstring/fatigue after internationals) will be fit for LASK; all three also missed the weekend 0-3 loss to Man City. Ekitike (Achilles rupture, April surgery, 9-12 month recovery window) remains out; Bradley (knee ligament/bone surgery, no timeline given) and Leoni (ACL surgery since Sep 2025, return to full training still unclear) are long-term absences with no indication either has returned. Sources: Sports Mole (Iraola presser), 3AddedMinutes, roundtable.io (28 Sep-14 Oct); goal.com LASK preview (names all five as unavailable); liverpoolfc.com/anfieldindex (Ekitike surgery/recovery); SI.com/goal.com/Irish Examiner (Bradley, Leoni). Re-checked for this Villarreal fixture (20 Oct): the trio were also absent for the weekend Man City loss per Sportsmole/Goal (14-15 Oct), and Iraola's own comments on their availability for the next fixtures remain uncertain -- no update either way found, so the doubt tags stand rather than being resolved. Re-checked again (20 Oct, matchday) for the Villarreal fixture: no update found either way on Isak/Gakpo/Szoboszlai's availability -- doubt tags stand; Ekitike/Bradley/Leoni remain out.

Militao and Mendy are back training but not match-ready -- Sports Mole's Oct 14 (match-day) roundup lists Militao's return as late October and says Mendy has no return date set and was left out of the Villarreal squad; a separate 'welcome back' piece about their return to training does not claim either is available for Roma. Rodrygo: long-term knee injury, not expected back until early 2027. Konate also appears on one preview (Africa Soccer) but is not corroborated by a second source -- not added. Sources: Sports Mole injury/suspension list (dated 14 Oct), Africa Soccer Roma-Real Madrid preview and 'welcome back' piece.

Goretzka's availability is directly contradicted between sources; a Hemmings minor-knock claim (missed Brentford, may return for this match) is single-sourced; Barkley/McGinn claims trace back to an unrelated Jan 2026 Europa League trip -- none added.
